text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: billing-metering-heartbeat-mismatch detected. Token emit counts diverging from shadow tally across region eu-west-1. Severity: P2. Paging billing-sre and oncall. Thread started 1717777000

leah (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Can someone confirm customer-visible overage flags?

ben (billing-sre): Seeing spike in overage flags for a few accounts — alerting CS. Not all customers, looks correlated to requests routed via proxy-v2.

kinga (cs): We've got 3 incoming tickets mentioning unexpected "quota exceeded" emails since 06:12 UTC. Customers seeing billing alerts but usage dashboard showing lower numbers.

mike (eng-ml): Hypothesis: KV cache TTLs for token windows didn't propagate after the 06:00 runtime rollout, causing double-counting on emitter fallback. Checking logs.

sara (eng-infra): Deploy-bot shows a canary at 05:58 with config change 'emit_route=fallback,ttl=30m' — rolling back now as precaution.

deploy-bot: rollback started for rollout 2024-11-07T05:58Z by sara (eng-infra).

ben (billing-sre): Quick query from metering-agg (last 15m):
```
select minute, sum(tokens_emitted) as emitted, sum(tokens_shadow) as shadow 
from token_agg 
where minute >= '2024-11-07T06:00:00Z'
group by minute order by minute desc limit 10;
-- results: 
-- 06:17 -> emitted: 5,120,345 shadow: 4,108,201
-- 06:16 -> emitted: 4,912,011 shadow: 4,110,678
-- 06:15 -> emitted: 2,010,123 shadow: 2,009,998
```
Notice divergence grows after 06:10.

leah (oncall): Good signal. Which service is emitting the extra tokens? Any request_id patterns?

mike (eng-ml): Filtering by emitter_id: getting many records from emitter 'proxy-v2' where fallback=true and retry_count>1. Looks like retries are re-emitting without dedupe.

ben (billing-sre): That matches: overage flags triggered by emitted>threshold per customer window. We should pause billing pipeline for affected accounts to prevent charging until we reconcile. Need approval from finance/CC.

tom (platform): I can open a temporary suppression rule in billing: suppress charge calc for accounts with tag "suspect-proxy-v2" until manual reconcile. Will need list of affected accounts (max 100).

kinga (cs): I'll collate the ticket IDs and affected account ids from support queue and push tag to accounts. ETA 10m.

leah (oncall): Meanwhile, mitigation steps: 1) rollback done? status? 2) stop emitter fallback path or add dedupe by request-id at emitter. 3) apply suppression.

sara (eng-infra): Rollback complete at 06:23 UTC — 2 canaries rolled back, remaining paused. No new canaries since.

mike (eng-ml): Patching emitter to drop retry-emits without idempotency check. Quick hotfix ready: PR#4523 — will deploy to staging then to canary.

ben (billing-sre): Starting immediate partial reconciliation job to estimate overcharged tokens and produce a delta report. Running dry-run now.

ben (billing-sre): Dry-run output (snippet):
```
AFFECTED_ACCOUNTS: 78
ESTIMATED_OVERCOUNT_TOKENS: 1,012,234
ESTIMATED_CUSTOMER_IMPACTED: 43 accounts with overage flags
```

kinga (cs): Pushing customer comms draft to #announcements-drafts for review: "We detected a billing anomaly for a subset of customers due to an internal emitter issue; we are suspending charges while we investigate and will reconcile."

leah (oncall): Good. Action items assigned: ben -> finalize suppression list and run reconciliation (priority). mike -> land dedupe hotfix to canary. sara -> confirm rollback and keep canaries paused. kinga -> send cautious customer comms once suppression is live. tom -> run suppression rule.

mike (eng-ml): Hotfix merged, starting canary deploy to proxy-v2-hotfix at 06:28 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy proxy-v2-hotfix to canary started by mike.

ben (billing-sre): Suppression rule applied for tagged accounts at 06:30 UTC. Billing engine will skip charge calc for those accounts until reconcile tag removed.

kinga (cs): First customer notified via support chat, tone: apology + assurance charges suspended. Receiving positive reception so far.

leah (oncall): Monitoring: token divergence trending down after rollback + suppression. Keep watch for re-emits. Post-mortem required. Keep this thread for handoff to morning oncall at 08:00 UTC.

ben (billing-sre): Preliminary mitigation metrics: 
- peak delta per minute reduced from ~1.0M to ~20k within 10m of rollback
- suppression active for 78 accounts
- reconciliation dry-run suggests refunds/credits likely needed for ~43 accounts

mike (eng-ml): Canary looks clean for the hotfix so far (5m). No retry-emits observed in emitter logs for canary shards.

leah (oncall): Great. If stable, we'll close pager at 08:00 and continue offline. Please add notes to the incident board and include runbook steps for emitter idempotency.

ben (billing-sre): Adding tags + exporting account list to secure drive for finance reconciliation.

tom (platform): Created incident ticket IN-2024-987 in Jira, assigned to billing and eng-ml for postmortem and customer remediation plan.

kinga (cs): I'll follow up with affected customers with timeline and next steps once finance confirms credit plan.

leah (oncall): Handing off to night-squad at 08:00 UTC. Good job. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigation in progress -> monitoring. Handoff scheduled 08:00 UTC to night-squad.

leah (oncall): Closing thread for live ops; keep updates in incident ticket.
